description: Fetch a single GitHub pull request by number, e.g. https://github.com/facebook/react/pull/37251. Returns number, title, state (open/closed/merged), merged and mergeable flags, author, full body text, base/head refs, labels, assignees, commit/change/review counts, and created/closed/merged dates. Pass --include_files true to also load the Files changed list (each file with filename, status, additions and deletions). Reads the rendered PR page plus GitHub's own page_data endpoints; no login required.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as owner/repo (e.g. facebook/react) or its full URL https://github.com/facebook/react. The owner/repo is parsed out; a repo alias (e.g. facebook/react -> react/react) is resolved automatically via GitHub's redirect.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Pull request number, e.g. 37251 in https://github.com/react/react/pull/37251. Use a positive integer; obtain numbers from github list-pulls or the PR page URL.

parameters.name: include_files
parameters.description: Set to true to also return the changed-files list from the Files changed tab, as an array of {filename, status, additions, deletions, changes}. Default false. Enabling loads the .diff endpoint so the command is slightly slower.
